description: Merge both open PRs into main. PR #1 (fix/android-startup-black-screen) is already contained in PR #2 (feat/migrate-firebase-to-supabase) as commit 11c7e2a. Merge PR #2 which contains everything, then close PR #1. Update local main branch.
steps: Use `gh api repos/gitworld08210/Parallaxai/pulls/1/merge -X PUT -f merge_method=squash` to merge PR #1 first (black screen fix)
Use `gh api repos/gitworld08210/Parallaxai/pulls/2/merge -X PUT -f merge_method=squash` to merge PR #2 (firebase-to-supabase migration which includes the black screen fix)
Run `git checkout main && git pull origin main` to update local main branch
Verify the merge was successful by checking git log
acceptance_criteria: Both PRs are merged/closed on GitHub
Local main branch is up to date with all changes from both PRs
git log on main shows the merged commits
verification: Run `bun run build` on main to confirm everything compiles
findings: Merged PR #1 first (squash), which caused PR #2 to become unmergeable (dirty state) since PR #2 already contained PR #1's commit 11c7e2a. Resolved by rebasing feat/migrate-firebase-to-supabase onto updated main (git automatically skipped the duplicate commit), then force-pushed and merged PR #2. Both PRs now closed. Build verified successfully on main.
